paper_title: A Lower Bound for Polynomial Calculus with Extension Rule
statement: 3. Theorem 21 says that any Res-LinB refutation of BVPn requires size 2Ω(n) . Does the exponential lower bound on the size of the Res-LinB refutation imply the exponential lower bound on the number of lines in the Res-LinB refutation? Do we necessarily need large coefficients in some Res-LinB refutations with a small number of lines? Or if there is a Res-LinB refutation with a small number of lines then there is a Res-LinB refutation with a small number of lines and small coefficients?
